remarks: Saudel is over. It is gone from the JMA targetTc feed for the first time this run, so Shanghai/Ningbo gets eventEnded 2026-08-30 and winds off the weather panel in two days. The backlog it left behind does not disappear with it — that story now belongs to the congestion chart.

No tropical cyclone anywhere near a tracked port. The two active systems, Bang-lang and Etau, are both tropical storms sitting well east of Japan around 165-166E. Closest approach across every analysis and forecast point is 3,288 km, Bang-lang to Busan, more than five times the 600 km threat radius. Neither carries a threat entry.

Shanghai/Ningbo is the only live port entry. Waits of 5 to 11 days depending on terminal, against 1.53m TEU at anchorage and a queue-to-berth ratio of 2.68 on the last Linerlytica snapshot. Gates are open, water side is not.

Xiamen has been dropped. Its eventEnded of 28 Aug has run out, feeder connections restarted, and its Linerlytica ratio of 0.29 on 27,320 TEU is the lightest queue of any tracked port. Nothing left to flag.

Heads up on the congestion chart, not the weather: Linerlytica has published nothing since 23 Aug. Its publish-date endpoint was checked live on 30 Aug and still ends there, so congestion.json is a week stale through no fault of this run and has been left untouched.
